name: Pi-hole
description: DNS server for your network that blocks ads and trackers.
notes: Web password: ${SECRET}. Point your router's DNS setting at this NAS.
compose:
services:
  pihole:
    image: pihole/pihole:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "53:53/tcp"
      - "53:53/udp"
      - "8053:80/tcp"
    environment:
      - TZ=${TZ}
      - FTLCONF_webserver_api_password=${SECRET}
      - FTLCONF_dns_listeningMode=all
    volumes:
      - ./etc-pihole:/etc/pihole
